decisions.reason: As a 2023 line with several models and its own page in both years, it reflects meaningful investment and visible commitment in the firm’s core range, which escalation of commitment makes management likely to continue.
This 2023 multi-model ceiling luminaire line remained prominently presented on its own page, so the sunk development and public positioning around the core offer make withdrawal unlikely.
Although newer, it is a full product line close to the established business and already given its own page, so management is likely to back it for longer rather than admit an early mistake.

This canopy extends the existing system offer and has been presented on its own page, so even with lower likely investment than a full line, it supports the announced modular growth direction and is likely to stay.
As a system-related add-on with its own page, it fits the firm’s modular and sustainable positioning, and management would usually continue it unless weak performance became unmistakable.

It is the least publicly committed product because it was only mentioned on the website, but as a close-to-core line in a growing market the firm would still more likely retain it than remove it quickly.
